maddeler.e:
احتضرتم (form VIII)
# اِحْتَضَرْتُمْ (iḥtaḍartum) /iħ.ta.dˤar.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# اُحْتُضِرْتُمْ (uḥtuḍirtum) /uħ.tu.dˤir.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
